It uses only the facts already on the site: olive oil at 14 € for 0.5 l, Piran salt at 4.5 € for 1 kg, and gift boxes from 25 €.

I'll insert it after the highlights section (index 3), before the gift section. The homepage already has an image-text section for gifts, so the products section stays short, at three items. The photos are img_01 (oil), img_02 (salt) and img_03 (gift box). The products section is not yet on the homepage, so the "at most once per page" rule is met.

The homepage sections are hero (0), strip (1), about (2), high (3), gift (4), cta (5). Inserting at index 4 puts the products between highlights and the gift section. Tone alt is used on about and gift, so the new section gets the default tone.
